title: Supply and Maintain a 20 Yard Container for Waste Connections
agency_path: City of New York > Homeless Services
description_text:
Waste Connections of New York Inc and the New York City Department of Homeless Services (DHS) Facilities and Logistics have an 18 month Supply, Install, & Maintenance of Self-Contained Compactor at Bellevue contract. The contractual agreement has a two (2) year renewal option. DHS Facilities and Logistics is requesting to exercise its option to renew.  

Waste Connections of New York Inc provides an ongoing service for supply, installation and maintenance of a self-contained compactor at 400 East 30th Street Mens Shelter. This type of service is essential to keep garbage and waste consolidated in one place and not scattered all over the facility. It is our responsibility to provide safe and secure environment for clients that we serve.

Waste Connections of New York Inc overall quality of service is satisfactory. The Contractors services to date have been timely. In addition, the Contractors performance is in compliance with the contract terms, adhering to schedules and milestones. For reasons mentioned above, DHS Facilities and Logistics believes it would be in the best interest of the City of New York to exercise the renewal option of this contract, which would save time and is most cost effective during these economic times.
Renewal CT Amt.: $210,600.00
Renewal CT Term:10/01/26-09/30/28
